title: Completed Prompt Library Log Data Contract
description: Additive structural schema validating completed Prompt Library Log artifact data payloads (PMO-05.09).

prompt_id.description: A short identifier, so a prompt can be referred to in a meeting without its text being read out. A number is enough if it is the only one in use.

use_case.description: What the prompt is for, in one line: the task it was written to do and the situation it was written in. A prompt filed without its use case cannot be told apart from another one that reads almost the same.

prompt_text.description: The prompt as it is actually sent, not a description of it. What is filed here has to be usable by pasting it, because a paraphrase is a different prompt and will behave differently.

expected_output.description: What a good answer looks like, specifically enough to be checked. This is the column that makes the library auditable: without it there is nothing to compare a later response against.

status_version.description: Where the prompt stands, and which version this is. A prompt that has been revised without the version moving leaves every earlier result attached to a text that no longer exists.
